items.name: Quickstep Tonic
items.description: A bitter green tonic with a sharp herbal finish that leaves the limbs light and restless.
items.effect: As a bonus action, drink the tonic. Your walking speed increases by 10 feet for 10 minutes.

items.name: Battle Balm
items.description: A pungent medicinal balm that numbs pain, tightens the skin, and lends a brief reserve of fighting strength.
items.effect: As a bonus action, apply the balm. You gain 2d6 + 2 temporary hit points. A creature cannot benefit from Battle Balm again until 24 hours have passed.

items.name: Tanglefoot Flask
items.description: A stoppered glass flask filled with an aggressively adhesive resin that spreads into fibrous strands when exposed to air.
items.effect: As an action, throw the flask at a creature within 20 feet. The target must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or become Restrained. A restrained creature can use its action to make a DC 13 Strength check, ending the effect on a success.

items.name: Ironhide Salve
items.description: A dense gray salve flecked with crystalline grit. Once worked into the skin it hardens into an almost imperceptible protective film.
items.effect: As an action, apply the salve. Your Armor Class increases by 1 for 1 minute.

items.name: Keenmind Draught
items.description: A silvery draught that seems perfectly still even when shaken. For a few moments after drinking it, thought and instinct become unnaturally precise.
items.effect: As a bonus action, drink the draught. For 1 minute, whenever you make an ability check or saving throw, add 1d4 to the roll.
